title: G6PD and ACSL3 are synthetic lethal partners of NF2 in Schwann cells
model: Human Schwann cells (ipn02.3 2λ) NF2-WT and NF2-KO, TKOv3 KO library
contrast: NF2-KO vs NF2-WT dropout, passage 7 vs passage 0 (genotype x time; 1+2 per genotype)
paper_method: Difference in log2FC (KO minus WT, passage 7 / passage 0), ranked
paper_calls: ACSL3 and G6PD as synthetic-lethal partners of NF2
barcs_calls: 314 genes at FDR 0.10 (122 depleted); 361 against the control null
verdict: BARCS confirms ACSL3 and G6PD as NF2-synthetic-lethal genes; its strongest interaction calls are WT-specific overgrowth genes (CUL3, NF2, TSC1, KEAP1) that the paper deliberately excluded.
